hazards.value: Walls break and reform as turns/area events occur. Opening near Nah can open other routes; exact triggers unknown. Long-range tomes and Counter-bearing Warriors are hazards.

interactables.value: Opened doors remain open according to guide; changing walls do not establish permanent safe chokepoints.

hazards.value: Flying reinforcements prioritize Tiki and can fly past the player’s army.
hazards.notes: Hard guide and independent Hard-labelled Japanese player report of losing Tiki agree on target priority. Does not prove exact reach/turns.

activation.value: Boss advances after reinforcement enemies are eliminated; exact final-wave enumeration unresolved.

timing.notes: Multiple flying waves; count and exact timing unknown. Record is an event family, not a complete list of individual waves.

spawn_phase.notes: Ordinary Hard arrivals act at enemy-phase beginning, but exact phase of this map-specific event was not directly established.

immediate_action.notes: Conditional application of VERIFIED ordinary Hard rule: if this is an ordinary beginning-enemy-phase arrival it can move/attack and kill immediately. This wave was not independently observed; scripted phase/exception uncertainty remains.
